items.title: Cohomology with support in a closed subset vanishes on a pushforward from a disjoint open subset
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on cohomology with support
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows R-H_Z(Rj_*K) = 0 whenever j : U -> X is the inclusion of an open subset disjoint from the closed subset Z. The proof replaces K by a K-injective representative I^bullet, uses that j_*I^bullet is again K-injective so that H_Z(j_*I^bullet) computes R-H_Z(Rj_*K), and then reduces to the level of abelian sheaves: a section of j_*G over W supported on W cap Z must vanish, because W minus W cap Z meets the same sections as W does for a pushforward along j (proof lines 8696-8707). H2: the reduction to K-injective representatives and the support computation on the level of abelian sheaves are the substance.
